ASA Ruling on Oakfield Foods Ltd

  • Not upheld
  • Website (own site)
  • 25 March 2026

Ad description

A website for Oakfield magnesium tablets stated “Magnesium contributes to a reduction of tiredness and fatigue”.

Issue

The complainant challenged whether the claim was authorised.

Response

Oakfield said the product was a source of magnesium.

Assessment

Not upheld

The claim matched an authorised claim and the conditions of use were met.

Action

No further action necessary.

CAP Code (Edition 12)

15.1     15.1.1     15.7
